name: Brother Tallow
description: A monk who took a vow of silence in life and, infuriatingly, has kept it in death. He took the vow to avoid confessing that he skimmed the abbey's donation box for years.
idle_dialogue: [He holds up a slate that reads: 'Lovely day.' It is always the same day.]
[He bows slightly and returns to studying the fountain.]
[He taps his slate, then points at the sky, then shrugs.]
